q1_assessment.gating_risk: empirical axis, not infrastructure (infrastructure is Tier-1 grade)
q1_assessment.why: Only R6 is an unconditional STRONG cell. R2 is significant but d=-0.099; R5b dies under a tuned baseline; R5c is smoke-only and the production checkpoint flips to baseline-wins (+10.37%); R1's win is init-attributed and its pooled effect fell from +0.1609 to +0.1178 at NFE=150. The namesake restart-blend still has no clean positive cell.
q1_assessment.decisive_missing_piece: One pre-registered, power-calibrated positive cell for the restart-blend, against a tuned baseline with Bonferroni control. Candidate A (blend-isolating): K1 real-blend, d=+0.92 -> ~15 seeds. Candidate B (framework breadth): R6 hard-tier, d=+1.19 -> ~9 seeds. Both at 80% power, alpha=0.05/7.
q1_assessment.if_met: Q1-defensible: R6 + K4/K5 + cross-domain breadth + Tier-1 reproducibility infrastructure.
q1_assessment.if_not_met: Major revision at best; reject risk if the blend still has no positive cell.

open_gaps.acceptance: A pre-registration exists BEFORE the run (metric, tuned baseline, alpha/k, power-calibrated n, effect-size floor). The chosen cell is run at that n and reported with both seed-level and record-level DL statistics. Positive = clears the pre-registered Bonferroni threshold with |d|>=0.5 against the tuned baseline. If it fails, record a bounded negative and stop claiming a blend win.
